step1_analysis.description: A non-inverting buffer consisting of a symmetric CMOS inverter followed by a standard inverter. The first stage uses parallel PMOS and series-parallel NMOS structures to match pull-up and pull-down drive strengths, achieving symmetric rise and fall times which is crucial for low phase noise in ring oscillators.

paper_reference.title: Write Pulse Generator for 16x DVD Recording With Symmetric CMOS Inverter Ring Oscillator

tpd_rise.description: Propagation delay from input rising to output rising

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay of two cascaded inverter stages with W=5u L=0.5u. The symmetric first stage has high drive strength and low fan-out to the second stage.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 at 1.8V is faster than the original 0.35um process, so the intrinsic delay of this cell will likely be under 100ps, though the paper reports a 149ps programmable resolution step.

tpd_fall.description: Propagation delay from input falling to output falling

sky130_expected.calculation: Should closely match tpd_rise due to the symmetric design of the first stage (NMOS effective L is doubled to match PMOS mobility).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetric inverters aim for tpd_rise ≈ tpd_fall to minimize phase noise.

trise.description: Rise time of the output signal (20% to 80%)

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the drive strength of XM7 (W=5u, L=0.5u) charging the 10fF load capacitor.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A 5um PMOS in SKY130 can easily charge a 10fF load in tens of picoseconds.

tfall.description: Fall time of the output signal (80% to 20%)

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the drive strength of XM8 (W=5u, L=0.5u) discharging the 10fF load capacitor.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Slightly faster than trise due to higher NMOS mobility, though the second stage is a standard inverter, not symmetric.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = C_total * VDD^2 * f. With ~20fF total switched capacitance at 250MHz (4ns period).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dynamic power dominates. Short-circuit power is minimized by the fast input edges.

sky130_expected.calculation: The symmetric first stage is designed to place the switching threshold exactly at VDD/2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: VDD is 1.8V, so ideal symmetric threshold is 0.9V.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure propagation delays, rise/fall times, power consumption, and DC switching threshold of the symmetric delay cell.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Symmetric Delay Cell Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VGND GND 0 0

* IN2 is tied high to enable the second parallel NMOS pull-down branch for symmetric operation
VIN2 IN2 0 1.8

* Pulse input for transient analysis (250 MHz)
VIN1 IN1 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 2n 4n)

* DUT
XM1 N4 IN1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 IN1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM6 N1 IN1 VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM8 OUT N4 VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM7 OUT N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM4 N0 IN1 VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N4 IN2 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM3 N4 IN1 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

* Load capacitor
Cload OUT 0 10f

.control
* Transient Analysis
tran 10p 10n

* Measure Propagation Delays
meas tran tpd_rise trig v(IN1) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran tpd_fall trig v(IN1) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.9 fall=1

* Measure Rise and Fall Times (20% to 80% of 1.8V)
meas tran trise trig v(OUT) val=0.36 rise=1 targ v(OUT) val=1.44 rise=1
meas tran tfall trig v(OUT) val=1.44 fall=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.36 fall=1

* Measure Average Power
let inst_pwr = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
meas tran avg_power avg inst_pwr from=0 to=10n

* DC Analysis for Voltage Transfer Characteristic (VTC)
dc VIN1 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc vth find v(IN1) when v(OUT)=0.9 rise=1

quit
.endc
.end
